decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered Application Form, Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Plans 1B, 2C, 3B, 4, 5A, 6A, 7A, 8B, 9B, 10B, Received 9 May 2013, 11D, 12D, 13B, 14B, 15B, 16C, 17B, 19C, 19B, 28, Received 30 May 2013 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 3 - The development shall be completed in the materials specified on the approved plans and within the Design and Access Statement, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of ground floor rear and side extensions, replacement front porch, double glazed windows, rooflights and a first floor roof terrace.
